_readme: Single source for the numbers that generation and linting must agree on. svgkit.py, drawiokit.py, svg-card-layout.cjs, lint-svg-text-overlap.cjs and lint-drawio-layout.py all read this file. Changing a value here changes both what gets drawn and what gets rejected, which is the point: when the generator and the linter kept private copies they drifted, and a figure that passed generation failed the lint for a rule the generator thought it had satisfied.
_aspectNote: Past this width:height ratio a page-width embed scales the figure down until body text stops being legible. Both routes hold the same line: drawiokit refuses to save one, lint-svg-text-overlap refuses to pass one.
_glyphNote: Advance width per em for the Noto Sans CJK SC / Microsoft YaHei stack. Generators lay out at narrowGlyphEm; linters measure at the wider narrowGlyphLintEm so a borderline line is caught rather than shipped. Never make the lint value the smaller of the two.
